title: Template Entity
description: Defines template rendering configuration. Used by weaver to route templates to engine plugins (go, jinja2, mustache, qute, freemarker).

engine.description: Template engine plugin name. Maps to weaver-<engine> binary (e.g., go, jinja2, mustache, qute, freemarker).

source.description: Path to the template source file, relative to the entity's location.

output.description: Output path for the rendered template (absolute or relative).

entity_types.description: Entity type URIs this template can render for.
